messages:
Alex: SOC asked for 13 months of security logs for investigations — we're on 90d default. Any constraints with SIEM export & RBAC? Also need to figure KMS key rotation for exported archives.
Maya: We can pipeline daily deltas to a dedicated SIEM S3 bucket, use lifecycle rules to move to cold storage after 90d and to delete at ~400d if legal allows. For access, create a dedicated `security-logs` IAM role with minimal permissions (no console access) and grant the SIEM service principal only `s3:GetObject`/`s3:ListBucket`. :thinking_face:
Samir: For incident triage we need immutability for at least 180d. Can we enable S3 Object Lock (WORM) on the SIEM bucket for critical streams?
Alex: Good point re WORM — any implications for re-ingestion or remediation runs?
Julia: If we enable Object Lock, we must define an emergency admin bypass with an approval workflow (audit trail required). Also, we must redact PII before exporting to the SIEM to stay GDPR-friendly — that changes the ingestion pipeline.
Maya: Agreed. Redaction should happen at the streaming stage (Kinesis/Lambda or our logproc). We can add a small processor to scrub emails/SSNs before writing to the export bucket. Example quick regex: `redact_regex: /[a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\\.[a-z]{2,}/`
InfraBot: IAM policy snippet for the SIEM role for ops team review:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-siem-logs", "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-siem-logs/*"]
    }
  ]
}
```
Samir: KMS notes: use a dedicated CMK (`cmk-security-logs`) with a tight key policy limiting use to the SIEM ingestion role and our security admin role. Limit `kms:Decrypt` to the SIEM principal, enable annual rotation, and ensure all CMK usage is logged in CloudTrail. Also mark the key in the compliance register.
SecurityBot: Policy change PR opened: #PR-4821 — auto-detected change to `logs:PutObject` permissions for `svc/splunk`. :robot_face:
Alex: Who's owning the RBAC change? We need an audit before rollout.
Maya: I'll own the RBAC PR. I'll add a canary export step and an automated smoke test to verify no gaps (sample count, checksums).
Samir: Also ensure we update retention metadata in the compliance register (control id SEC-LOG-RET-03) and attach the Object Lock rationale.
Julia: Heads-up for finance: storing 13 months will increase infra spend ~+18% for logs. We need approval for budget delta.
Alex: Plan: Maya -> PR + runbook, Samir -> validate Object Lock & KMS, Julia -> create compliance & finance tickets. Target rollout next Wed 09:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Maya: Sounds good — I'll drop the runbook and the redaction lambda example in the PR.
SecurityBot: Reminder: scheduled key rotation for `cmk-security-logs` in 3 days. :bell:
Alex: Thanks all — I'll create a short coords thread with the timeline and owners.
